title: Linh's Sweet Comfort
segments: Linh woke up feeling hot and tired in her Hanoi apartment. Her head ached badly. It was time for her first online class, but focusing on the screen was hard. The teacher's voice sounded far away. She tried to read the text, but the words blurred. This fever made everything difficult.

Because of this, Linh's older sister, Mai, walked in. She saw Linh trying to focus on her laptop, her face pale and tired. Mai immediately noticed Linh's discomfort. It was clear Linh needed help. Mai remembered how her grandmother always made chè đậu xanh for them when they were sick.

After that, Mai went to the kitchen. She found an online recipe for chè đậu xanh. Carefully, she measured the ingredients: mung beans, sugar, and coconut milk. The kitchen filled with a sweet smell. Meanwhile, Linh was still at her laptop. She tried to read about ancient history, but her head still hurt.

Soon, Mai carefully carried a warm bowl of chè đậu xanh to Linh. The sweet aroma filled Linh's room. Linh looked up, her eyes tired. She took a spoonful. The familiar sweet taste was comforting. A warm feeling spread through her. Feeling a little stronger, Linh managed to review some history notes for a few minutes.

Because of this, Linh felt much better after eating the warm chè đậu xanh. Her head no longer hurt as much, and her fever seemed to lessen. Mai smiled, seeing Linh's improved energy. Linh opened her laptop again, feeling ready to tackle her history lessons. The sweet comfort truly helped her focus and learn.

After that, Linh confidently resumed her online history class. Her mind felt clear, and her energy was back. She could easily understand the teacher's words and participate actively. Mai watched, happy to see Linh smiling and learning again. The chè đậu xanh and Mai's loving care had truly helped Linh recover. She finished her lessons with renewed focus.
endWrap: Linh's fever was gone, and she could learn again. Mai's care and the sweet chè helped her feel better. Their bond grew stronger through this comforting experience.
